curator_note: A Wooli-weekend unofficial afters with a secret DTLA location, but it's riddim and bass all the way down. Only for the afterhours-and-mystery-address crowd; musically it's off your path.
description: Unofficial late-night afterparty for the Wooli weekend with a TBA downtown location, billed as dubstep, riddim and drum and bass.

curator_note: Gudfella is a name I can't vouch for, and the listing gives no support or label context. It's a standard Hollywood house night, so I'd only go if friends are already headed there.
description: Saturday-night house set at Sound Nightclub in Hollywood, 10pm to 2:30am.

artist_notes.name: Adrian Mills
artist_notes.note: Billed for an all-night-long set; the listing frames it as eurodance/hardstyle/hard techno.

curator_note: Fun, a bit unhinged, and built around one DJ playing all night. But it's eurodance and hardstyle energy, not the groove you usually chase. Go for the spectacle, not the selection.
description: Factory 93's 240 KM/H night at Ace*Mission Studios: an all-night Adrian Mills set with Serafina and zwilling., leaning eurodance and hard techno.

artist_notes.name: Interplanetary Criminal
artist_notes.note: Manchester producer riding the UK bassline/2-step revival; skippy, rave-adjacent garage.

curator_note: Interplanetary Criminal is a name already on your radar, and this one's at an off-the-grid-feeling address on Mission Rd. It's a bassline and garage night more than house, but that's a fun detour, and it's a long way off in February.
description: UK garage and bassline producer Interplanetary Criminal with Osmosis Jones at 560 S Mission Rd.

artist_notes.name: Joyce Manor
artist_notes.note: Torrance-born emo/punk band, short punchy songs; a cult favorite.

artist_notes.name: The Linda Lindas
artist_notes.note: LA punk band of young musicians, Epitaph-signed, with a following well beyond local.

artist_notes.name: Interpol
artist_notes.note: NYC post-punk revival band from the early 2000s, moody and driving.

curator_note: The annual KROQ Forum bill is stacked: Foo Fighters, Weezer, Sublime and Interpol in one night. It's an arena rock night rather than a club one, but Weezer is in your rotation and the post-punk end with Interpol is real.
description: KROQ's annual holiday concert at the Kia Forum with Foo Fighters, Weezer, Sublime, Interpol, Joyce Manor and more.

artist_notes.name: Nic Fanciulli
artist_notes.note: UK tech-house and techno DJ who runs Saved Records; long-time festival and club mainstay.

artist_notes.name: Paco Osuna
artist_notes.note: Spanish techno/tech-house veteran, a Plus 8 and Intec regular; shown on the Dice listing as a co-headliner.

curator_note: Fanciulli and Paco Osuna on one Framework bill is two veteran tech-house and techno names playing for hours. This is probably the best straight-ahead dance floor in the batch. The $74+ ticket is steep, but it's the one I'd look at.
description: Framework presents Nic Fanciulli with Paco Osuna at Reframe Studios, 10pm to 2am.

curator_note: Free indie-sleaze dance party at Zebulon. It's more nostalgia-flavored than a proper house night and the lineup's a mystery, but it's close to home and costs nothing. A decent late stop if you're already nearby.
description: Free late-night indie sleaze party at Zebulon in Frogtown, with indie dance, synthpop and electro house.

artist_notes.name: Oden & Fatzo
artist_notes.note: UK duo playing house, electro and UK garage.

curator_note: Oden & Fatzo is a UK duo doing bouncy house with a garage edge. At $25 it's a cheap Avalon night, but expect big-room Hollywood energy rather than a proper European club.
description: UK duo Oden & Fatzo at Avalon Hollywood playing house, electro and UK garage.

artist_notes.name: Big Freedia
artist_notes.note: New Orleans bounce icon, the genre's best-known ambassador; high-energy, twerk-driven shows.

curator_note: Big Freedia at Los Globos is a proper bounce party in a small room, a big name somewhere intimate. It's not house, but it's likely the most fun night on this page and an easy walk from home.
description: Barbazon's Bitch Planet night at Los Globos with New Orleans bounce star Big Freedia, UNiiQU3, Star Amerasu and Cquestt.
